title: Two-Tier Dish Rack – Drying Space for All the Dishes in 42 cm
descriptionHtml:
The dishes fight over one drip tray

Plates balance on the glasses, the cutlery lies in a heap and the cutting board leans against the tiles. Every dinner ends with the same game of Tetris at the sink.

Two tiers that give everything its place

Plates and cutting board stand on edge where they dry, the glasses hang upside down on their own pegs, the cutlery has its own compartment – and under it all sits a drainage tray that leads the water where you want it. 42 × 28 cm on the counter, 29 cm high.

Features

  • Dinner dishes for the whole family fit – two tiers instead of one cramped tray
  • Glasses dry upside down – their own pegs, no water rings at the bottom
  • No water on the counter – the drainage tray leads into the sink
  • Cutlery and cutting board have their own compartments – nothing sloshes around
